Name: Pau's Rose Gold Artisan and Refining Stuff
Author: suzukiPC
Description:
[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/how-to-install2.png[/img]

﻿1) Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
2) Download the file and unzip it; extract it into your Mods folder

[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/features.png[/img]

﻿1) Retextures artisan items, refining items, signs, and some miscellaneous craftable items
﻿✨ Artisan

﻿ ﻿[spoiler] ﻿ ﻿- Mayonnaise Maker
﻿ ﻿- Bee House
﻿ ﻿- Preserves Jar
﻿ ﻿- Cheese Press
﻿ ﻿- Loom
﻿ ﻿- Keg
﻿ ﻿- Oil Maker
﻿ ﻿- Cask
﻿ ﻿- Fish Smoker
﻿ ﻿- Dehydrator[/spoiler]

﻿✨ Refining
﻿ [spoiler]﻿ ﻿ ﻿- Charcoal Kiln
﻿ ﻿- Recycling Machine
﻿ ﻿- Seed Maker
﻿ ﻿- Crystalarium
﻿ ﻿- Furnace
﻿ ﻿- Heavy Furnace
﻿ ﻿- Lightning Rod
﻿ ﻿- Tapper
﻿ ﻿- Heavy Tapper
﻿ ﻿- Worm Bin
﻿ ﻿- Deluxe Worm Bin
﻿ ﻿- Bait Maker
﻿ ﻿- Geode Crusher
﻿ ﻿- Solar Panel
﻿ ﻿- Bone Mill
﻿ ﻿- Slime Incubator
﻿ ﻿- Slime Press
﻿ ﻿- Ostrich Incubator[/spoiler]

﻿✨ Misc
﻿ ﻿[spoiler] ﻿ ﻿- Garden Pot
﻿ ﻿- Scarecrow
﻿ ﻿- Deluxe Scarecrow
﻿ ﻿- Staircase (with matching ladders!)
﻿ ﻿- Jukebox
﻿ ﻿- Mini Obelisk
﻿ ﻿- Farm Computer
﻿ ﻿- Hopper
﻿ ﻿- Statue of Blessings
﻿ ﻿- Statue of the Dwarf King
﻿ ﻿- Anvil
﻿ ﻿- Mini Forge[/spoiler]

﻿✨ Signs
﻿ ﻿[spoiler] ﻿ ﻿- Text Sign
﻿ ﻿- Wood Sign
﻿ ﻿- Iron Sign
﻿ ﻿- Monster Sign[/spoiler]

2) Each item is toggleable to on/off in [b]Generic Mod Config [/b]Menu in case you might like a different retexture from a different mod c:
